snippet.title: Resonurgy | Factory Automation Meets Magic | Official Trailer | Out now
snippet.description:
Play the FREE demo and wishlist Resonurgy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5011960/Resonurgy/

Build a factory powered by conveyor belts, alchemy, and golems!

Resonurgy is a Factorio-inspired factory automation game where industry meets magic. Design your production lines, combine machinery with alchemy, and put golems to work as you build and expand your factory.

Magic becomes an increasingly important part of your production as you progress, with principles and rifts at the heart of the world.

Coming to Steam Early Access on October 16, 2026.

Try the free demo and share your feedback. We'd love to hear what you think!

#Resonurgy #FactoryBuilding #AutomationGame
